items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: a young boy who was about 18 playing acoustic and Tommy DeVito, he was one of the Four Seasons. There was four guitarists.

ctx.x: So what is the, sort of the assignment of roles between those two or three guitar players? What is one person doing and the other person doing?

Oh okay, I’ve done that too, for the Four Seasons. Again that’s sort of like a rock group, we call that rock. We’ve had, I think there were four guitar players on that if I recall. Vinnie Bell. You’ve heard of Vinnie Bell I think? Vinnie was on it. There was someone, a young boy who was about 18 playing acoustic and Tommy DeVito, he was one of the Four Seasons. There was four guitarists. My part was just to play, not rhythm like big band style, just arpeggio type rhythms every — maybe in a measure you’d have the…
Was someone assigned to the, just the two and four?
